notes:
• What's new in 1.0.5:
• Each post keeps its own post card. Pick a card for a post in Create post or Edit post.
• Writing a post: the post card, hashtags, training checkbox and toolbar slide away while you type, and come back when the keyboard closes.
• Tap an attached photo or video to view it full screen before posting.
• Edit post now has the same Link, Photos, Videos, Camera and Record toolbar as Create post.
• The training checkbox explanation is folded under Show more.
• If an update cannot install, the app shows the reason Android gave.
• The name is now written KinetixFSL everywhere.
